title: Orthogonal projection onto the range of an injective linear map depends continuously on the map
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ. Consider the map A ↦ P_{range A} from L(ℝⁿ, ℝᴺ) to L(ℝᴺ, ℝᴺ), where L(·,·) consists of all linear maps with the operator-norm topology and P_K is the orthogonal projection of ℝᴺ onto the subspace K (Submodule.starProjection). This map is continuous on the set S = {A ∈ L(ℝⁿ, ℝᴺ) : A injective}, with its relative topology.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ), ContinuousOn (fun A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N ↦ (LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap).starProjection) {A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N | Function.Injective A}
